name: AES token fees burned and paid out of the pair's own balance
summary: AES treats any transfer out of its pair as a buy: it burns 3% from the pair and adds 1% to swapFeeTotal, and the public distributeFee() pays six times swapFeeTotal out of the pair's AES balance, neither followed by a sync. The attacker repeatedly skimmed the pair to itself to burn its AES and grow swapFeeTotal, called distributeFee and sync to collapse the AES reserve, and swapped AES for the pair's USDT.
notes: Loss is the AES/USDT pair's USDT; the pair's 2.6m AES burned or sent to fee wallets is valued at nothing (rule 12).
